jei.floraexpansion.apple_core.info.1: Apple cores are planted like saplings.
jei.floraexpansion.apple_core.info.2: Eating apples has a 50% chance to leave behind an apple core.
jei.floraexpansion.bottled_juice.info.1: Drinking this returns an empty glass bottle.
jei.floraexpansion.bottled_juice.info.2: The bottle is given back to the inventory or dropped nearby if there is no space.
jei.floraexpansion.cactus_armor.info.1: Cactus armor can retaliate against direct melee attackers.
jei.floraexpansion.cactus_armor.info.2: Wearing more pieces increases the chance, and 3 or more pieces hit harder.
jei.floraexpansion.cactus_armor.info.3: Fire Aspect on cactus armor can ignite attackers, but Thorns cannot be applied.
jei.floraexpansion.cactus_cluster.info.1: Place more cactus clusters onto the same block to build up the cluster.
jei.floraexpansion.cactus_cluster.info.2: Use a glass bottle to extract cactus juice.
jei.floraexpansion.cactus_cluster.info.3: Each bottle use reduces the cluster by one stage.
jei.floraexpansion.cactus_flower.info.1: Cactus flowers can grow into giant cacti on sand or suitable terracotta.
jei.floraexpansion.cactus_flower.info.2: They can transform on their own over time.
jei.floraexpansion.cactus_flower.info.3: Bonemeal can also trigger giant cactus growth when there is enough room.
jei.floraexpansion.cactus_thorn.info.1: Cactus thorns damage living entities that pass through them.
jei.floraexpansion.cactus_thorn.info.2: They can be attached to floors, walls, or ceilings if the supporting block is sturdy enough.
jei.floraexpansion.cherries.info.1: Eating cherries has a 50% chance to leave behind a cherry pit.
jei.floraexpansion.cherries.info.2: Cherry pits can be planted to grow cherry trees.
jei.floraexpansion.cherry_pit.info.1: Cherry pits are planted like saplings.
jei.floraexpansion.cherry_pit.info.2: They can also come from eating cherries.
jei.floraexpansion.flax_seed.info.1: Flax grows into a two-block crop once it reaches its taller stage.
jei.floraexpansion.flax_seed.info.2: Right-click the upper half with shears to harvest the crop without replanting.
jei.floraexpansion.flax_seed.info.3: Shearing resets flax back to a small lower-half plant so it can regrow faster.
jei.floraexpansion.flax_seed.info.4: Bonemeal can advance flax growth and helps it reach the harvestable tall stage sooner.
jei.floraexpansion.fruiting_cherry_leave: Fruiting cherry leaves slowly ripen over time.
Right-click by hand to harvest cherries once fruit has grown.
jei.floraexpansion.fruiting_oak_leaves.i: Fruiting oak leaves slowly ripen apples over time.
Right-click by hand to harvest an apple once the leaves are fully ripe.
jei.floraexpansion.giant_cactus_base.inf: Use an axe to strip giant cactus base blocks.
Stripping can knock loose a cactus thorn.
jei.floraexpansion.giant_cactus_stem.inf: Touching giant cactus stems deals cactus damage.
Use an axe on the stem to harvest the whole connected stem column into cactus slices.
Stems can keep growing upward and may produce cactus flowers at the top.
jei.floraexpansion.giant_cactus_wood.inf: Use an axe to strip giant cactus wood blocks.
Stripping can knock loose a cactus thorn.
jei.floraexpansion.leaf_litter.info.1: Right-click with an empty main hand to gather twigs from leaf litter.
jei.floraexpansion.leaf_litter.info.2: Thicker patches can yield more twigs.
jei.floraexpansion.leaf_litter.info.3: Bonemeal increases the patch up to 4 layers instead of spreading to a new block.
jei.floraexpansion.leaf_litter.info.4: Using bonemeal on a full 4-layer patch drops another leaf litter block.
jei.floraexpansion.opuntia_cactus.info.1: Opuntia cacti slowly ripen prickly pears over time.
jei.floraexpansion.opuntia_cactus.info.2: Right-click to harvest ripe fruit without breaking the plant.
jei.floraexpansion.pebble_patch.info.1: Place more pebble patches onto the same block to build up the patch.
jei.floraexpansion.pebble_patch.info.2: Right-click with an empty main hand to pick the pebbles back up.
jei.floraexpansion.pebble_patch.info.3: A fuller patch returns more pebbles.
jei.floraexpansion.pebbles.info.2: Thrown pebbles deal damage and usually drop themselves again on impact.
jei.floraexpansion.pine_cone.info.2: Thrown pine cones deal a small amount of damage and briefly slow targets.
jei.floraexpansion.pine_cone.info.3: On impact, they sometimes drop 1 or 2 pine nuts.
jei.floraexpansion.pine_cone.info.4: Burning pine cones can drop toasted pine nuts instead.
jei.floraexpansion.pine_litter.info.1: Right-click with an empty main hand to gather pine cones and twigs from pine litter.
jei.floraexpansion.pine_litter.info.2: Thicker patches can yield more pine cones and more twigs.
jei.floraexpansion.pine_litter.info.3: Bonemeal increases the patch up to 4 layers instead of spreading to a new block.
jei.floraexpansion.pine_litter.info.4: Using bonemeal on a full 4-layer patch drops another pine litter block.
jei.floraexpansion.prickly_pear.info.1: Prickly pears are the fruit harvested from opuntia cacti.
jei.floraexpansion.prickly_pear.info.2: The item can also be planted to place a new opuntia cactus.
